# TPC-Havoc Q14_v4

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
select
    100.00 * sum(promo_revenue) / sum(total_revenue) as promo_revenue
from (
    select
        sum(case when p_type like 'PROMO%' then l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) else 0 end) as promo_revenue,
        sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as total_revenue
    from lineitem, part
    where l_partkey = p_partkey
      and l_shipdate >= date '1995-09-01'
      and l_shipdate < date '1995-09-01' + interval '1' month
      and p_type like 'PROMO%'

    union all

    select
        0 as promo_revenue,
        sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as total_revenue
    from lineitem, part
    where l_partkey = p_partkey
      and l_shipdate >= date '1995-09-01'
      and l_shipdate < date '1995-09-01' + interval '1' month
      and p_type not like 'PROMO%'
) combined
```
